_comment: PDFs offered for download on the Publications page. Add an entry only when sharing the file is allowed, e.g. an accepted manuscript under the publisher's author-sharing policy, or an open-access (CC BY) article. Put the file in public/papers/. version: published | accepted | submitted. The id is the publication's id in publications.json. Entries are checked before every build.

journal-203.permission: Elsevier sharing policy: accepted manuscript on the author's personal website, with a link to the published article (CC BY-NC-ND).
